author: Linnaeus, 1758
habitat: 강가와 하천 둘레의 풀밭, 농경지, 섬과 바닷가의 풀밭
summary: 우리나라에는 아주 드물게 찾아오는 길잃은새로, 2006년 12월 흑산도에서 처음 기록된 뒤 한강 팔당·미사리와 인천, 제주 등지에서 겨울부터 봄 사이에 몇 차례 기록되었다. 트인 풀밭과 농경지의 땅 위를 걸어 다니며 곤충과 그 애벌레, 거미 따위를 주로 먹고 가끔 풀씨도 먹는다. 유럽 북부와 아이슬란드에서 서시베리아 북부에 걸쳐 번식하고, 겨울에는 유럽 남부와 북아프리카, 중동으로 내려간다.

points.en: greyish- to olive-brown upperparts streaked dark
breast and flanks heavily streaked dark

young: 어린새는 어른새와 거의 같으나 윗면의 어두운 무늬가 더 또렷하고, 아랫면에 누런빛이 더 돈다.

similar.how: 나무밭종다리는 몸이 조금 더 크고 뒷발톱이 짧고 많이 굽었으며, 옆구리의 세로줄이 가슴보다 훨씬 가늘다.
붉은가슴밭종다리는 허리와 위꼬리덮깃에도 검은 줄무늬가 뚜렷하지만, 풀밭종다리는 허리에 줄무늬가 거의 없다.

art.subject: Meadow Pipit (Anthus pratensis), adult in winter (sexes alike), a vagrant in Korean farmland: upperparts olive-brown with dark streaks on the crown and mantle, the rump plain and unstreaked; face rather plain with a faint pale supercilium, a pale eye-ring and a thin dark malar stripe; wings brown with two narrow pale wing bars and pale-fringed tertials; underparts whitish with a buff wash on the breast and flanks, the breast densely marked with fine dark streaks that continue as thinner streaks along the flanks; outer tail feathers white. Bill thin and dark with a pale base to the lower mandible; eye dark; legs pinkish.
art.pose: walking among short grass, side view
art.scene: stubble fields and grassy dykes in Korean farmland in winter (December–February), low winter sun; no people, buildings or text
views: adult in winter, side view walking in short grass, body horizontal: greyish- to olive-brown upperparts streaked dark, buff-washed breast, breast and flanks heavily streaked dark, whitish belly, thin pointed bill, pinkish legs

adult in flight seen squarely from above: head, body and tail in one line, wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span, dark-streaked olive-brown upperparts, dark tail with white outer feathers
art.build: Small, slim pipit about the size of a sparrow but slimmer, with a rather small head, thin bill and horizontal posture; walks and runs in short grass. Bill thin and straight, about half the length of the head. Legs medium length, pinkish, with a long, gently curved hind claw. At rest the tertials almost cover the primaries (short primary projection). Tail medium length, slightly notched, dark with white outer edges.
avoid: Do not paint a brick-red throat or a streaked rump — those belong to Red-throated Pipit; Meadow Pipit's rump is plain.
Do not paint a bold face with a white and black spot behind the ear coverts — that is Olive-backed Pipit.
Do not paint black legs; Meadow Pipit's legs are pinkish.
Do not paint bold white stripes ('braces') on the mantle (Red-throated or Pechora Pipit).
